text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! How… how can you say that?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What grounds do you have to say that when I just keep losing and losing?!
choice_data_list: I know how hard you work!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …It worked, Trainer. Thanks to you…that stupid weak feeling is totally gone.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You're always lookin' out for me and pushin' me forward.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I can't sit around forever! That'd be even lamer than losin'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So it's settled! I'll get that win someday and show everyone just how cool I am!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I haven't met my fans' expectations yet… Or yours.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: And most of all, I still haven't shown myself what I'm really capable of!
choice_data_list: Then keep trying, however many times it takes!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Yeah… You're right! It isn't like me to sit around whinin'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If I'm not good enough right now, then I've just gotta keep on pushin'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Just you wait, Trainer! I'm gonna make sure I show ya how cool I can really be!
